summary: Maintenance log — attach PDF document to log entry
description: Users can upload a single PDF attachment to any maintenance log entry. The upload replaces any previously attached file. Only PDF format is accepted.

acs.text: An 'Attach File' button is displayed on each maintenance log entry row
Clicking the button opens the system file browser filtered to PDF files only
If a non-PDF file is selected, the upload is rejected with the inline error: 'Only PDF files are accepted'
After a successful upload, the attached filename is displayed below the log entry with a remove link
